entries.name: Missing streetlight
entries.description: Lighting expected but column or lamp absent.

entries.name: Hidden traffic sign
entries.description: Sign obscured by foliage, hoardings or vehicles.

entries.name: Missing warning sign
entries.description: Hazard present without the warning sign normally expected.

entries.name: Missing lane markings
entries.description: No lane guidance on a multi-lane road.

entries.name: Damaged signboard
entries.description: Bent, faded or defaced sign that is hard to read.

entries.name: Vegetation obstruction
entries.description: Plants encroaching on the road or blocking sight lines.

entries.name: Blind junction
entries.description: Junction where approaching traffic cannot be seen in time.

entries.name: Restricted sight distance
entries.description: Sight distance below what the approach speed requires.

entries.name: Low overhead clearance
entries.description: Wires, branches or structures low over the road.

entries.name: Narrow shoulder
entries.description: Shoulder too narrow for stopping or two-wheelers.

entries.name: Roadside encroachment
entries.description: Stalls, parked vehicles or structures occupying road space.
